plot: Pip's Grandma Rosa visits Wheelburg for the first time, but the moment she sees Grumpy she zooms behind Benny's bakery and won't come out; everyone thinks Grumpy's big hook scared her, until Bolt reads her dropped note card ('Grumpy: tell him a joke') and learns she hid because she knows no jokes; Grumpy, who doesn't tell jokes either, quietly parks beside her to watch the leaves, they both laugh, and Rosa asks to see the old race track 'by the big oak' where she once raced — but Wheelburg has no race track.

script.title: Why Is Pip's Grandma Hiding?!
script.description: Grandma Rosa came to meet Pip's friends. Then she saw Grumpy and hid. Inspector Bolt #29

set.place: Bakery Lane outside Benny's bakery and Pip's house, a sunny autumn afternoon with falling leaves until sunset

beats.say: Oh dear, oh dear! Not now! I'm not ready!
Grandma, wait! Why are you hiding from my friends?
She looked at me. Then she ran. That's a first.
It was a sunny autumn afternoon on Bakery Lane. Leaves were falling.
And Pip's grandma had come to Wheelburg for the very first time.
She drove all the way from the seaside! Just for you!
And I baked a welcome pie! Pumpkin, with extra cinnamon!
So where is she? I want to show her my zoom!
She was right here. Reading her little card. Like always.
A little card, Pip?
Grandma writes notes for everything. Shopping, birthdays, even hellos.
Just a minute before, Grandma Rosa had rolled up, smiling.
Hello, Bolt dear! Procedure! There, I said it right.
Very good, madam. Procedure, indeed.
And you must be Turbo. Fast! Fast, fast, fast!
She knows me! I'm famous at the seaside!
And Bertha, the loudest, kindest bus. Hello, sweetie!
HELLO, ROSA! Oops. Was that too loud?
Then a grey tow truck rolled slowly around the corner.
Oh! The big grey one. Grumpy. Oh, oh dear!
And Grandma Rosa zoomed behind the bakery. Just like that.
It's the hook. Grandmas don't like big hooks.
Or your face, Grumpy. It's a very... serious face.
This is my happy face.
Oh, Grumpy. Don't be sad. We'll fix this!
But Grandma only stays until tomorrow at sunset!
If she hides, she'll never meet my best friends!
Then we need the facts. Procedure, everyone.
Bolt rolled quietly toward the bakery corner.
Madam Rosa? It's only Bolt. May we talk?
Not yet, dear! I'm... I'm reading! Give me one minute!
Something white fluttered down from behind the wall.
Her note card. She dropped it.
Read it! Read it! What does it say?
Bolt, say Procedure. Turbo, say fast. Bertha, say hello.
Aww! She practised a word for each of us!
And Grumpy? What's the word for Grumpy?
There's a leaf stuck on that part. And a little smudge.
It says, Grumpy, hide. I knew it.
Grumpy turned to go home, very slowly.
Tell Rosa I'm sorry. I'll park far away.
No, Grumpy! Please don't go! Wait!
I have an idea! We give Grumpy a happy disguise!
We could put my pie on his hook! Pies are friendly!
No pie on the hook.
Then smile! Show your teeth, Grumpy. Like this! Cheese!
Trucks don't have teeth, Turbo.
Wait. A detective doesn't guess. A detective cleans the clue.
Bolt blew the leaf away. Whoosh.
Grumpy. Tell him a joke.
Grandma has to tell GRUMPY a joke? Ha!
The sun is going down! The pie is getting cold!
Oh no. I know why she's hiding now.
I told her Grumpy never laughs. Not even once.
Grandma doesn't know ANY jokes. She always forgets the end!
She wasn't scared of Grumpy. She was scared of getting it wrong.
She was scared... for me? To make me laugh?
Grumpy rolled slowly to the bakery corner. Very gently.
Rosa. I don't know any jokes either.
You don't?
Not one. I just like to sit. And watch leaves.
Oh! I like that too. At the seaside, I watch waves.
I'm sorry I ran, Grumpy. My wheels just went whoosh.
Mine do that at parties. I park behind the cake.
Behind the cake! Oh, that is a very good spot.
So the two of them parked side by side. Quiet. Watching.
Turbo zoomed closer to see. Too fast.
Whoa, whoa! Brakes! Brakes!
A big red leaf landed right on his nose.
Who turned off the lights? I can't see!
Hee hee hee! Oh my!
Heh. Heh heh.
Grandma! You did it! You made Grumpy laugh!
No, dear. The leaf did. We just watched it together.
Grandma and Grumpy are friends now! Real leaf friends!
You don't need perfect words. You just need to be there.
Then everyone shared Bertha's pumpkin pie as the sun went down.
Still warm! A tiny bit!
Pip, dear, tomorrow I want to see the race track.
The round one, by the big oak. I won my first race!
Grandma, you were a RACER?!
Number seven! The fastest purple car on the whole coast!
Wait! There's no race track in Wheelburg! Not one!
No race track? But it was right here. I'm sure of it.
What do you think Bolt will find next time? We'll find out in the next episode!
